query:
UPDATE mcp_artifacts
            SET session_id = COALESCE(session_id, $2),
                trace_id = COALESCE(trace_id, $3),
                ai_tool_call_id = COALESCE(ai_tool_call_id, $4),
                last_seen_source = COALESCE($5, last_seen_source)
            WHERE artifact_id = $1
